name: Misasagi
message: 「Well, I was just thinking how I've gone and gotten another year older.」

name: Misasagi
message: 「At this rate, before I know it, I'll probably end up in the twilight of my life.」

name: Misasagi
message: 「It's not as though I'm blaming you, mind you.」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Because the present you gave me made me ever so happy.」

name: Misasagi
message: 「So, to tell you the truth, I thought that getting older isn't so bad after all.」
